process.heading: Our Mobile Screen Design Process
process.subtitle: A structured, platform-aware approach that transforms your app idea into stunning, user-tested mobile screens.

steps.title: Discovery & Mobile Strategy
steps.description: We begin by understanding your app's purpose, target audience, and platform requirements. Our team analyses competitor apps, user behavior patterns, and platform-specific conventions (iOS HIG & Material Design) to define a winning mobile strategy.

steps.title: User Flow & Screen Architecture
steps.description: We map every user journey across all screens — onboarding, core features, settings, and edge cases. A clear screen architecture ensures smooth navigation and zero dead ends for your users.

steps.title: Wireframe & Low-Fi Screens
steps.description: We create low-fidelity wireframes for every key screen before applying visual design. This ensures layout, content hierarchy, and interaction patterns are validated early — saving time and budget.

steps.title: High-Fidelity Screen Design
steps.description: We craft stunning, pixel-perfect high-fidelity screens following iOS Human Interface Guidelines and Material Design 3 principles. Every screen is designed for multiple device sizes — from small phones to large tablets.
points: Hi-fi screens for all app states

steps.title: Micro-interactions & Prototyping
steps.description: Static screens come alive with thoughtful micro-interactions, transitions, and animations. We build interactive prototypes in Figma so you can experience the real feel of the app before development begins.

steps.title: Developer Handoff & Support
steps.description: We deliver organized Figma files with auto-layout, design tokens, and platform-specific assets — iOS @1x/@2x/@3x and Android dp/sp specs. Our team supports developers throughout implementation to ensure pixel-perfect output.

faqs.question: Do you design for both iOS and Android?
faqs.answer: Yes. We design platform-specific screens for both iOS (following Apple's Human Interface Guidelines) and Android (following Material Design 3). We also create unified cross-platform designs for React Native and Flutter apps.

faqs.question: How many screens are included in a mobile design project?
faqs.answer: It depends on your app's scope. A typical MVP app has 20–40 screens. We provide a detailed screen list and timeline after our initial discovery call — no hidden surprises.

faqs.question: Do you design dark mode versions of the screens?
faqs.answer: Yes. We design both light and dark mode variants for all screens as standard practice, along with accessibility-compliant color contrast ratios.

faqs.question: What files will I receive after the project?
faqs.answer: You'll receive organized Figma source files, exported iOS assets (@1x/@2x/@3x), Android assets (mdpi/hdpi/xhdpi/xxhdpi), design tokens, and a developer spec sheet via Zeplin or Figma Dev Mode.

faqs.question: Can you redesign my existing mobile app screens?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We start with a thorough UX audit of your current app to identify drop-off points and usability issues — then redesign screens strategically for better retention and conversion.
